milestones.description: Uses count_in_box_at_most(kind='mob', object='zombie', max_count=0) to verify the zombie has been killed. This rule type is preferred for kill/combat tasks because the zombie has PersistenceRequired:1b (won't despawn) and the arena is enclosed with solid stone brick walls (±8 blocks), so the only way the zombie count reaches 0 inside the generous ±15 detection box is if the player kills it. Verified in sandbox: zombie spawns at relative (5,0,5), well within the detection box, and actively approaches the player for combat.
